packages.name: Nexa Backup - Backup & Migrate

packages.name: Nexa Cache — Speed Cache
packages.author: NexaCMS

packages.name: Nexa Comments — Threaded Comments & Moderation

packages.name: Nexa Downloads — Protected Downloads, Email Gates, Timers, Purchases & Approvals
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Protected tracked downloads: public, logged-in, customer, email-gated and admin-approved access; free-download countdown timers; expiring download limits; purchase verification through Nexa Shop or purchase claims; entitlements, requests, logs and shortcodes.

packages.name: Nexa Duplicate - Clone Posts & Pages
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Yoast Duplicate-Post style: one-click clone of any post/page as a draft.

packages.author: NexaCMS

packages.name: Nexa File Manager
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Backend file manager for admins: browse the whole site, upload files, create folders, rename, edit text/code files, download and delete - with path-traversal protection and guarded system files (config.php, database stores).

packages.name: Nexa Forms - Form Builder
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: WPForms/Contact-Form-7 style builder: design forms, embed with [nexa_form id="1"], read submissions in admin.

packages.name: Nexa Gallery — Media Gallery & Lightbox
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Upload/order gallery images and display a responsive grid lightbox with [gallery].

packages.name: Nexa Image Optimizer - Compress Images
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Smush style: scan content/uploads, report oversized images and resize them with GD in one click.

packages.name: Nexa Import / Export — Posts & Pages
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Export posts and pages as portable JSON, or as a FULL ZIP including every referenced media file (images, audio, video, uploads) with automatic URL rewriting on import. Skip/overwrite/duplicate modes + dry run.

packages.name: Nexa Live Chat — AI/FAQ First Contact, Agent Queue & Capacity
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Persistent site-wide chat bubble. Direct JSON API endpoint, FAQ/systematic or AI first contact, bulk FAQ import (CSV/TSV/JSON/text with followups column), smart suggestions on both ends (visitor starter/follow-up chips from hand-picked, auto-related or AI follow-ups; agent suggested replies that insert for editing), automatic escalation to a human queue, per-agent concurrent-chat capacity, agent console with reply-to-take-over, floating admin alert bubble (badge/sound/desktop alerts), FAQs, history and settings.

packages.name: Nexa Menu Organizer
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Declutters the admin sidebar: groups every plugin's menu into categories (Content, Marketing & SEO, Commerce, Security & System, Utilities).

packages.name: Nexa Newsletter — Subscribers & Export
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Newsletter signup [newsletter_form] with token unsubscribe and Admin subscriber CSV export.

packages.name: Nexa Post Layouts — Listing Layouts & Ad Slots
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Create named post-listing layouts: blocks before/after the list, ad or shortcode blocks inserted between posts (after every Nth post), columns per row and card styles. Assign layouts to the blog home, search results, or everywhere.

packages.name: Nexa Redirects - 301s & 404 Log
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Redirection style: manage 301/302 redirects in pre and log 404s so you can fix broken links. Redirects can keep selected GET parameters (e.g. theme) across the jump. Rules are per-site: main-site redirects never reroute subsites, and local targets stay inside the current site.

packages.name: Nexa Repository Hub — Serve Plugins & Themes
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Turns this NexaCMS site into a package repository: other NexaCMS sites can add this site as a Repository and browse/install the plugins and themes you choose to publish. Serves a repo index JSON and on-the-fly package zips of your shared installed plugins/themes.

packages.name: Nexa Security — Login Guard & Audit Log
packages.author: NexaCMS
packages.description: Brute-force login rate limiting, IP blocking and an admin audit log.

packages.name: Nexa SEO — Meta, OpenGraph & Sitemap
packages.author: NexaCMS

packages.name: Nexa Shop — Store, Cart, Checkout & Orders

packages.description: Full WooCommerce-style store: catalog with categories/search/sort, product pages, coupons, cart, shipping zones with flat/weight-based/free/pickup rates per country, checkout (COD, bank transfer, PayPal, Stripe), orders with stock control, customer My Account with downloads — plus a setup wizard that creates the store pages and collects your store details.

packages.name: Nexa Site Kit - Google Tools
